items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant effects
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome 2，預測細胞特異性 DNA 變異影響
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and variants affect specific human cell types rather than averaging across tissues. Trained on over 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues, it identifies nearly twice as many causal variants as its predecessor on key datasets and is available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGenome 2，這是下一代模型，能預測 DNA 序列及其變異對特定人類細胞類型的影響，而非僅對組織平均。它在超過 68 種組織的 1 億多細胞檔案上訓練，在關鍵數據集上識別因果變異的數量幾乎是前代的兩倍，並透過 AlphaGenome API 開放給非商業研究使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Cell-type conditional prediction moves genomics from bulk averages toward mechanistic disease insights, potentially accelerating target discovery; commercial access remains limited for now, and real-world validation against experimental data will determine impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 細胞類型條件式預測將基因組學從整體平均推進到疾病機制層面，可能加速靶點發現；目前商業存取仍有限，實際影響取決於與實驗數據的驗證結果。
items_flat.quote: AlphaGenome 2 is our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
items_flat.quote_zh: AlphaGenome 2 是我們的下一代模型，能預測 DNA 序列及其變異對特定人類細胞類型的影響，為科學家提供強大新工具以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 as its most capable models for demanding technical work in coding, finance, and the sciences. Fable 5.2 is available to paid users and platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, with standard pricing at $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens; Mythos 5.2 remains gated for cybersecurity and life sciences via verification programs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，作為其在編碼、金融與科學等艱鉅技術工作上最能幹的模型。Fable 5.2 已向付費用戶及 AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Foundry 等平台開放，標準價格為每百萬輸入 token 8 美元、每百萬輸出 token 40 美元；Mythos 5.2 仍透過驗證計畫限於網路安全與生命科學使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Positions Anthropic’s technical-work tier with lower prices than the prior Fable 5.1 while keeping high-risk capabilities tightly controlled; sustained performance on multi-day autonomous tasks will be the key differentiator versus peers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Anthropic 的技術工作層級以低於前代 Fable 5.1 的價格定位，同時嚴格控管高風險能力；在多日自主任務上的持續表現，將成為與同儕的關鍵差異。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作最能幹的模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域樹立新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API and Gemini Decision 1 model
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API 與 Gemini Decision 1 模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model, enabling evaluation of up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric questions in a single pass over multimodal inputs (text, images, audio, video, PDFs). It returns calibrated probabilities in 150-250 ms at $0.10 per million input tokens with no output token charges.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 推出由全新 Gemini Decision 1 模型驅動的 Gemini Decisions API，可在單一前向傳遞中評估最多 1,000 個是非、選擇或評分問題，涵蓋文字、圖像、音訊、影片與 PDF 等多模態輸入。端到端延遲 150-250 毫秒，輸入每百萬 token 0.10 美元，不計輸出 token。
items_flat.analysis_en: Specialized scoring without token-by-token generation targets high-volume agent routing, policy checks, and grading where latency and cost dominate; adoption will hinge on calibration reliability versus generalist models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 無需逐 token 生成的專門評分，針對高量代理路由、政策檢查與評分等延遲與成本關鍵場景；採用程度取決於校準可靠性是否優於通用模型。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini Decisions API，這是由全新 Gemini Decision 1 模型驅動的快速閉集決策端點。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，加速現實世界靈巧能力
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving dexterity, reliability, and speed across more than 200 tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept with Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids, it achieved 96% success on pick-and-pack operations, with 30-100% higher success rates and 20-30% faster completion versus prior baselines.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是其迄今最能幹的視覺-語言-行動模型，提升超過 200 項任務的靈巧性、可靠性與速度。在與 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人於 Mercedes-Benz 的概念驗證中，取放包裝作業成功率達 96%，相較先前基線成功率提升 30-100%，完成時間加快 20-30%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Gains in unstructured environments and factory pilots mark progress toward deployable physical AI, but success rates still vary widely by task and long-term robustness outside controlled settings remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在非結構化環境與工廠試點的進步，標誌著可部署實體 AI 的進展，但任務間成功率差異仍大，受控環境外的長期穩健性尚未證實。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是我們迄今最能幹的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes available to developers and Ultra users
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 開放給開發者與 Ultra 用戶
items_flat.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work, available to paying developers and enterprises via the Gemini API and to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode. Introductory pricing remains $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 將其在網路安全與長時程代理任務最強的模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，開放給付費開發者與企業透過 Gemini API 使用，並向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini 應用與 AI Mode 中推出。介紹期價格仍為每百萬輸入 token 2 美元、每百萬輸出 token 10 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader access after a limited cyber-defender rollout tests whether Carbon’s higher token usage for thorough reasoning delivers net value versus Argon on production workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在有限網路防禦者推出後擴大存取，將檢驗 Carbon 為徹底推理而使用更多 token 的做法，在生產工作負載上是否比 Argon 更具淨價值。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，開發者可使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 進行建置，這是我們在網路安全與長時程能力上具備前沿表現的最強模型。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that, guided by Gemini agents, generated over 6 million lines of Lean proofs to mathematically verify key security properties of Signal’s cryptographic protocol code. Human experts needed to review only about 1% of the critical sections.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，這是一個代理框架，在 Gemini 代理引導下生成超過 600 萬行 Lean 證明，對 Signal 加密協議程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學驗證。人類專家僅需審查約 1% 的關鍵部分。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure; scaling to larger or less modular codebases and independent audits will determine broader applicability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 展示 AI 輔助正式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模；擴展至更大或較少模組化的程式碼庫，以及獨立稽核，將決定更廣泛適用性。
items_flat.quote: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol.
items_flat.quote_zh: Google DeepMind 研究人員引導 AI 代理，對 Signal 協議底層實際程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學證明。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow for Class A shares
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Class A 股 IPO 路演
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The offering comprises 825 million shares (801 million by the company and the rest by existing stockholders), with an expected price range of $70–$78 per share and a Nasdaq listing under the symbol ANT.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 Class A 普通股擬議首次公開發行的路演。發行包含 8.25 億股（公司提供 8.013 億股，其餘由現有股東提供），預期價格區間為每股 70–78 美元，並申請在 Nasdaq 以 ANT 代號上市。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves Anthropic from private to public-market scrutiny while its S-1 remains effective only after SEC review; valuation and capital allocation between research, safety, and growth will face investor scrutiny.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Anthropic 從私募推向公開市場審視，而 S-1 僅在 SEC 審查後才生效；估值以及研究、安全與成長之間的資本配置，將面臨投資人檢視。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 Class A 普通股擬議首次公開發行的路演。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, lightweight model for high-volume agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，針對高量代理任務的輕量模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for repetitive agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. Priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens with a 1M context window, it is available on the Meta Model API and Muse Code as the first model trained using Muse Wonder Full.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Ember，這是其最小且最高效的模型，專為工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析等重複性代理工作設計。價格為每百萬輸入 token 0.10 美元、每百萬輸出 token 0.50 美元，具備 100 萬 token 上下文窗口，作為首個使用 Muse Wonder Full 訓練的模型，已在 Meta Model API 與 Muse Code 上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targets the cost floor for the bulk of agent traffic by pairing with larger models; closed weights limit independent verification of claimed efficiency gains versus open alternatives.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過與較大模型搭配，瞄準代理流量主體的成本下限；封閉權重限制對所宣稱效率增益相較開源替代方案的獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行以及代理整天重複的工作而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk signals soft rollout of Grok 4.8 to Bot users
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 透露 Grok 4.8 將軟性推出給 Bot 用戶
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.8 pre-training is complete, reinforcement learning is underway, evaluation scores are improving, and xAI will conduct a limited soft rollout to Grok Bot users later in the week of November 10. No full public or API launch has been announced by xAI.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 表示 Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成、強化學習進行中、評估分數開始提升，xAI 將在 11 月 10 日當週稍後對 Grok Bot 用戶進行有限軟性推出。xAI 尚未宣布完整公開或 API 推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Executive signaling of incremental progress rather than a formal release; performance relative to Grok 4.7 and competitors will only be assessable after broader availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 屬於執行層對增量進展的訊號，而非正式發布；相較 Grok 4.7 與競爭對手的表現，僅在更廣泛可用後才能評估。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic 2026 Usage Policy update takes effect
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 2026 使用政策更新生效
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s updated Usage Policy, first published in October, takes effect on November 12. Changes include a consolidated section on deceptive campaigns or artificial activity, clarified high-risk rules for health and finance, and controls for autonomous physical actions.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月發布的更新使用政策，於 11 月 12 日生效。變更包括將欺騙性活動或人工活動整合為新章節、釐清健康與金融等高風險規則，以及對自主物理行動的控制。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reflects observed misuse patterns and longer autonomous agent use; enforcement consistency across enterprise customers will determine practical impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 反映已觀察到的濫用模式與更長自主代理使用；對企業客戶的執法一致性，將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.
items_flat.quote_zh: 更新後的政策於 11 月 12 日生效。

google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving dexterity, reliability, and speed across more than 200 tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept with Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids, it achieved 96% success on pick-and-pack operations, with 30-100% higher success rates and 20-30% faster completion versus prior baselines.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是其迄今最能幹的視覺-語言-行動模型，提升超過 200 項任務的靈巧性、可靠性與速度。在與 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人於 Mercedes-Benz 的概念驗證中，取放包裝作業成功率達 96%，相較先前基線成功率提升 30-100%，完成時間加快 20-30%。
google.analysis_en: Gains in unstructured environments and factory pilots mark progress toward deployable physical AI, but success rates still vary widely by task and long-term robustness outside controlled settings remains unproven.
google.analysis_zh: 在非結構化環境與工廠試點的進步，標誌著可部署實體 AI 的進展，但任務間成功率差異仍大，受控環境外的長期穩健性尚未證實。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是我們迄今最能幹的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。

google.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes available to developers and Ultra users
google.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 開放給開發者與 Ultra 用戶
google.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work, available to paying developers and enterprises via the Gemini API and to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode. Introductory pricing remains $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
google.summary_zh: Google 將其在網路安全與長時程代理任務最強的模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，開放給付費開發者與企業透過 Gemini API 使用，並向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini 應用與 AI Mode 中推出。介紹期價格仍為每百萬輸入 token 2 美元、每百萬輸出 token 10 美元。
google.analysis_en: Broader access after a limited cyber-defender rollout tests whether Carbon’s higher token usage for thorough reasoning delivers net value versus Argon on production workloads.
google.analysis_zh: 在有限網路防禦者推出後擴大存取，將檢驗 Carbon 為徹底推理而使用更多 token 的做法，在生產工作負載上是否比 Argon 更具淨價值。
google.quote: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
google.quote_zh: 即日起，開發者可使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 進行建置，這是我們在網路安全與長時程能力上具備前沿表現的最強模型。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that, guided by Gemini agents, generated over 6 million lines of Lean proofs to mathematically verify key security properties of Signal’s cryptographic protocol code. Human experts needed to review only about 1% of the critical sections.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，這是一個代理框架，在 Gemini 代理引導下生成超過 600 萬行 Lean 證明，對 Signal 加密協議程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學驗證。人類專家僅需審查約 1% 的關鍵部分。
google.analysis_en: Demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification at practical scale for widely used infrastructure; scaling to larger or less modular codebases and independent audits will determine broader applicability.
google.analysis_zh: 展示 AI 輔助正式驗證在廣泛使用基礎設施上的實用規模；擴展至更大或較少模組化的程式碼庫，以及獨立稽核，將決定更廣泛適用性。
google.quote: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol.
google.quote_zh: Google DeepMind 研究人員引導 AI 代理，對 Signal 協議底層實際程式碼的關鍵安全屬性進行數學證明。

meta.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, lightweight model for high-volume agent tasks
meta.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，針對高量代理任務的輕量模型
meta.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for repetitive agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. Priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens with a 1M context window, it is available on the Meta Model API and Muse Code as the first model trained using Muse Wonder Full.
meta.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Ember，這是其最小且最高效的模型，專為工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析等重複性代理工作設計。價格為每百萬輸入 token 0.10 美元、每百萬輸出 token 0.50 美元，具備 100 萬 token 上下文窗口，作為首個使用 Muse Wonder Full 訓練的模型，已在 Meta Model API 與 Muse Code 上線。
meta.analysis_en: Targets the cost floor for the bulk of agent traffic by pairing with larger models; closed weights limit independent verification of claimed efficiency gains versus open alternatives.
meta.analysis_zh: 透過與較大模型搭配，瞄準代理流量主體的成本下限；封閉權重限制對所宣稱效率增益相較開源替代方案的獨立驗證。
meta.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
meta.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行以及代理整天重複的工作而設計。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk signals soft rollout of Grok 4.8 to Bot users
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk 透露 Grok 4.8 將軟性推出給 Bot 用戶
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.8 pre-training is complete, reinforcement learning is underway, evaluation scores are improving, and xAI will conduct a limited soft rollout to Grok Bot users later in the week of November 10. No full public or API launch has been announced by xAI.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 表示 Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成、強化學習進行中、評估分數開始提升，xAI 將在 11 月 10 日當週稍後對 Grok Bot 用戶進行有限軟性推出。xAI 尚未宣布完整公開或 API 推出。
xai.analysis_en: Executive signaling of incremental progress rather than a formal release; performance relative to Grok 4.7 and competitors will only be assessable after broader availability.
xai.analysis_zh: 屬於執行層對增量進展的訊號，而非正式發布；相較 Grok 4.7 與競爭對手的表現，僅在更廣泛可用後才能評估。

brief_en: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA prediction and Gemini Robotics 2.5 for real-world dexterity, while opening Gemini 4 Carbon more broadly and launching the Decisions API. Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 remain central amid its IPO roadshow; Meta's Muse Ember targets efficient agent workloads. xAI signals Grok 4.8 soft rollout.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome 2 細胞特異性 DNA 預測模型與 Gemini Robotics 2.5 實體靈巧能力，並擴大 Gemini 4 Carbon 可用性、上線 Decisions API。Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.2／Mythos 5.2 持續為焦點，同時推進 IPO 路演；Meta 的 Muse Ember 針對高效代理任務。xAI 透露 Grok 4.8 軟性推出。
